_about: Every public-domain Andrew A. Bonar (Andrew Alexander Bonar, 1810-1892, Collace and Glasgow) text the Word Hoard holds: his own works, the Memoir of M'Cheyne, and editions he made of others (marked 'ed. Bonar'; the base text is the other author's, the sketch and notes are Bonar's). Posthumous diary, letters and selections printed before 1931 are public domain and marked. Not Andrew Redman Bonar (1818-1867, a different writer), not Andrew Bonar Law, not Horatius Bonar (his brother, own shelf).
